contracts.description: Reads UTF-8 text with bounded line ranges, including notebook JSON, using the official DSH reader. PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF images return image content only when the calling model supports image input. PDF requires document conversion to text/Markdown first. Read an existing file completely before overwriting it.

errorCodes.when: The canonical target crosses a forbidden symbolic link.
The canonical target is absent or not a regular readable file.
The requested projection is unsupported.
The requested or decoded content exceeds a declared bound.

contracts.name: Read
contracts.resultSemantics: Return the official bounded UTF-8 text view or validated image content for an image-capable calling model. PDF conversion belongs to document processing.

contracts.description: Creates a new file or atomically replaces a previously read file. Writes follow the current sandbox mode; after a workspace-write denial, request one approved retry with sandbox_permissions and justification. Existing files require a current complete Read receipt.

errorCodes.when: An existing target has no current complete Read receipt.
The target changed after its qualifying Read.
The target changes identity or the sandbox denies the write.
The atomic commit precondition no longer matches.

contracts.name: Write
contracts.resultSemantics: Create missing parents through the checkpoint journal, atomically publish one managed file, and return its identity and eligible root checkpoint receipt. Rollback removes only recorded, unchanged, empty directories.

contracts.description: Performs an exact string replacement in a UTF-8 text file using official DSH edit semantics, including CRLF preservation. Writes follow the current sandbox mode; after a workspace-write denial, request one approved retry with sandbox_permissions and justification. By default old_string must occur exactly once; replace_all replaces every non-overlapping occurrence.

errorCodes.when: The target has no qualifying Read receipt.
old_string has no exact occurrence.
old_string is ambiguous while replace_all is false.
The target or publication precondition changed.

contracts.name: Edit
contracts.resultSemantics: Commit exact non-fuzzy replacement and return count, new identity, retained-change notice, and eligible checkpoint receipt.

contracts.description: Finds files by glob pattern under a readable directory. Results include ignored files, are ordered by modification time, and are capped at 100 paths.

errorCodes.when: The search root is unavailable or changes identity.
The glob pattern is invalid or over limit.
The bounded search failed after validation.

contracts.name: Glob
contracts.resultSemantics: Return at most 100 canonical paths ordered by modification time with explicit truncation.

contracts.description: Searches file content with the artifact-pinned ripgrep executable. The optional path may name a file or directory. Supports content, file-name, and count modes without invoking a shell.

errorCodes.when: The search root is unavailable or changes identity.
The expression or option combination is invalid.
The pinned ripgrep executable is unavailable.
The bounded search process fails.

contracts.name: Grep
contracts.resultSemantics: Return bounded content, file-name, or count records with stable pagination and truncation metadata.

contracts.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

errorCodes.when: Product execution policy denies the call.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

contracts.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

errorCodes.when: Product execution policy denies the call.

contracts.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

errorCodes.when: The target directory changes identity.
The target is absent or not a readable directory.
The bounded provider enumeration fails.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)
Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

contracts.name: ls
contracts.resultSemantics: Return the retained lowercase ls textual result with alphabetical entries, directory suffixes, dotfiles, and exact truncation bounds.

contracts.description: Fetches an HTTP or HTTPS URL under the Runtime network policy, converts supported content, and answers the supplied prompt with a tool-free utility model call.

errorCodes.when: The operation network policy denies the request or redirect.
Scheme, credentials, DNS, IP, redirect, or rebinding checks reject the destination.
The response cannot be converted safely.
The isolated tool-free utility call fails.

contracts.name: WebFetch
contracts.resultSemantics: Return a bounded utility-model answer with final URL, citations, converted-content provenance, and separately metered usage.

contracts.description: Searches the web through a supported Provider server-side adapter and returns cited results and available service text. Warnings identify unverified results or domain filtering; do not present unverified text as confirmed sources. This tool is absent when the operation-frozen Provider has no compatible adapter.

errorCodes.when: The frozen Provider has no approved server-side search adapter.
Domain constraints conflict or exceed bounds.
The Provider returns a failure, rate limit, or invalid result.

contracts.name: WebSearch
contracts.resultSemantics: Return bounded Provider-native cited results, available service text and separately attributable usage. Empty matches are valid; incomplete result formats retain text with explicit uncertainty. HTML scraping fallback is forbidden.

contracts.description: Asks one to four structured questions and waits without a human-decision timeout for the single registered response to this tool call. Use only when the interaction owner is available; the wait ends on an answer, explicit cancellation, or authoritative operation/Session termination.

errorCodes.when: No interactive or deterministic headless provider can answer.
The interaction owner rejects or expires the request.
A late or duplicate response loses exactly-one settlement.

header.description: Short display heading; prefer twelve characters or fewer.
Short display heading; prefer twelve characters or fewer.

contracts.name: AskUserQuestion
contracts.resultSemantics: Return the one registered answer set, including explicit free text when Other is selected.

contracts.description: Enters persisted plan mode and allocates or resumes its managed plan artifact. Plan mode immediately restricts execution to plan-safe actions.

errorCodes.when: The caller is not the root Agent or hard policy disallows entry.
The durable plan state cannot be created or resumed atomically.

contracts.name: EnterPlanMode
contracts.resultSemantics: Persist plan mode and return the managed plan artifact identity and revision before the restricted catalog becomes visible.

contracts.description: Submits the current managed plan revision for approval. Approval exits plan mode; rejection or cancellation keeps plan mode active.

errorCodes.when: No approval provider is available.
The submitted revision is no longer current.
Approval is rejected, cancelled, or expired while plan mode remains active.

contracts.name: ExitPlanMode
contracts.resultSemantics: Approval returns the submitted plan and normal mode; rejection or cancellation returns feedback while plan mode remains active.

contracts.description: Loads one model-invocable SKILL.md from the operation-visible approved DSH Skill catalog, strips frontmatter, expands deterministic arguments, and returns its bounded instructions inline. Pass args as one string: $ARGUMENTS expands the full string, indexed/numbered placeholders expand parsed arguments; without placeholders the arguments are appended in an ARGUMENTS section.

errorCodes.when: The named Skill is absent from the frozen catalog.
The Skill disables model invocation.
The resource cannot be validated or expanded within bounds.

contracts.name: Skill
contracts.resultSemantics: Return bounded frontmatter-stripped instructions from the exact operation-visible declarative Skill catalog.

contracts.description: Policy for native subagent and fork_agent delegation. DSH owns fresh/forked Sessions, continuable conversations, result delivery and lifecycle. MyAgents applies the admitted Host model, workspace, permission and Plan policy.

errorCodes.when: Host policy denies delegation.

contracts.name: Agent
contracts.resultSemantics: Use the installed native delegation result; no ProductWork handles or role registry.

contracts.description: Policy for native interrupt_agent. Interrupt the addressed child turn without closing its conversation or descendants; DSH returns acceptance immediately.

errorCodes.when: Host policy denies interruption.
The target is absent from the native Agent registry and child catalog.

contracts.name: TaskStop
contracts.resultSemantics: Native interrupt acceptance; no subtree stop or resource-finalization receipt.

contracts.description: Policy for native send_message and list_agents. Native messaging addresses a direct continuable child or the resident child's direct parent by agent_id. Delivery confirmation is not the recipient's answer. DSH owns the catalog and Inbox.

errorCodes.when: Host policy denies messaging.

contracts.name: SendMessage
contracts.resultSemantics: Native delivery confirmation and catalog; no ProductWork mailbox or sibling messaging.

contracts.description: Create a task for your own work. Without list, it belongs to this agent's personal list and other agents cannot access it through Task tools. Use meaningful steps for multi-step work, not trivial one-step answers. Only the root agent may use list: shared for collaborative work; shared tasks start unassigned and must be assigned or offered with TaskUpdate. This does not create a MyAgents product task, reminder, or scheduled automation.

errorCodes.when: The graph or metadata bound is reached.
The append cannot commit against the current revision.

contracts.name: TaskCreate
contracts.resultSemantics: Append one task to the Session-local TaskGraph and return its immutable ID and committed revision.

contracts.description: Read one task by ID in your personal list by default, or pass list: shared for collaborative work. Read its requirements and blockers before changing it. You can read only your own personal tasks and shared tasks assigned or offered to you. Use TaskList in the same list to discover IDs. Missing and inaccessible tasks have the same not-found result.

errorCodes.when: The task is absent or not visible.
The durable graph projection cannot be read safely.

contracts.name: TaskGet
contracts.resultSemantics: Return one task and graph revision from the durable Session-local projection.

contracts.description: List this agent's personal tasks by default. Use list: shared to inspect collaborative tasks assigned or offered to you. The root agent sees all shared tasks; a child sees only its own shared work. An empty shared result reveals nothing about other agents' tasks. After finishing shared work, list again to find newly unblocked work.

errorCodes.when: The durable graph projection cannot be read safely.
The projection exceeds its declared output bound.

contracts.name: TaskList
contracts.resultSemantics: Return a bounded stable task list and graph revision from the Session-local projection.

contracts.description: Update a task by ID in your personal list by default, or pass list: shared for collaborative work. Read its latest state with TaskGet first. Only the root agent may assign shared work to a continuable child or offer it to specific child IDs with offerTo. An offered child may claim an unassigned, unblocked task atomically. Do not claim someone else's task, change another agent's personal list, or mark unfinished work complete. Use the exact child runtime ID returned by subagent, fork_agent, or list_agents for owner/offerTo; owner: root names the root agent. Claim offered work with status: in_progress (owner is inferred). Normal statuses are pending, in_progress, completed; completed tasks may be corrected or reopened. Use status: deleted to remove obsolete work and clean all dependency references; deleted returns task: null. The legacy cancelled status is retained for compatibility and does not resolve blockers. An empty or unchanged update succeeds without changing the list revision. addBlocks/addBlockedBy add dependencies within the same list; cycles are rejected. metadata values of null remove keys. Results carry the list revision at the top level.

errorCodes.when: The target task does not exist.
A dependency is absent, cross-Session, self-referential, or cyclic.
The graph revision precondition fails.

contracts.name: TaskUpdate
contracts.resultSemantics: Atomically update one task and dependency graph and return the committed task, graph revision, and changed fields.
